purpose: read status and bounded sanitized output for a Broker-owned asynchronous job.

source.source_text: Purpose: read status and bounded sanitized output for a Broker-owned asynchronous job. Input: job_id:string, tail_bytes?:0..524288. Output: queued/running/completed/failed/cancelled, timestamps, exit/result class, bounded output. Contract: L2 read_only; scope mac.job.read; target job_id; timeout 5000ms; cap 512KiB; network none; filesystem broker_job_artifacts only; redaction mandatory; approval trusted_read; idempotent yes. Phase 3 planned.
